The Idea

A neighbourhood spot that doesn't try too hard to be found.

Pull up a stool along the old shophouse window, or settle into the back where the light comes soft through terrazzo and timber fretwork. One all-day menu, from the first coffee to the last plate — no separate breakfast or dinner rules, just come whenever and order whatever you're in the mood for.

Inside, wherever the light lands
